issues.claim: VEW-01's new rule makes N2's moat and field fallbacks 'taken per bank (N3: the parts of the graph the water divides …)', but N3 builds that graph after N2 and includes 'N2's outfall-run edges' in it; the text neither orders the steps (banks before N2's per-bank admission and fallbacks, outfall runs after), nor says which bank an outfall candidate belongs to, nor how 'the bank's stretch of `R`'s boundary' (the field outfall's search and the no-dry-boundary case) is cut from `R`'s boundary when banks are graph components rather than land regions. Two implementations could choose different outfalls for the same seed (ambiguous normative text in a deterministic stage).
